outcome: Early initiation of breastfeeding (within the first hour after birth)
Exclusive breastfeeding at six weeks postpartum
finding: The study found sub-optimal rates of early initiation of breastfeeding and exclusive breastfeeding in Ethiopia, with significant regional variation and factors such as cesarean delivery and obstetric complications negatively impacting breastfeeding practices.
mod_finding: Mothers who had cesarean delivery were less likely to initiate early breastfeeding compared to mothers with vaginal delivery.
